out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the handsink to the left of the 3 vat sink had a garden hose connected to it in order to spray water on the floor for easy clean up.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC WHY HAVING A GARDEN HOSE CONNECTED TO THE HAND WASHING SINK WAS NOT ALLOWED. EHS DISCUSSED OTHER OPTIONS WITH PIC AS TO HOW THEY CAN GET HOT WATER FOR CLEANING THE FLOOR THAT IS NOT FROM THE HAND SINK. PIC UNSCREWED THE HOSE FROM THE HAND SINK.

violations.title: Access to Handwashing Sink
violations.observation: The handwashing facility located to the left of the 3 vat sink is blocked by a table with multiple dry stock items preventing access by employees for easy handwashing.
violations.corrective_action: A hand washing sink shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for employee use. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC THAT ALL HAND SINKS NEED TO BE EASILY ACCESSIBLE FOR EMPLOYEES TO WASH THEIR HANDS. PIC WAS ABLE TO MOVE THE TABLE OVER THE HAND WASHING SINK COULD BE ACCESSED.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There is no test kit located in the facility for monitoring the concentration of the chemical sanitizing solutions.
violations.corrective_action: PIC ORDERED CHLORINE TEST STRIPS FROM AMAZON BEFORE THE INSPECTION WAS COMPLETED. PIC SHOWED EHS THE INVOICE FROM THE ORDER.

violations.title: Availability of Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There are no chemical sanitizers for sanitizing equipment and utensils available in the establishment.
violations.corrective_action: Except for those that are generated on-site, at the time of use, chemical sanitizers that are used to sanitize equipment and utensils shall be provided and available for use during all hours of operation. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC THAT SANITIZER IS ALWAYS NEED AT THE FACILITY TO BE ABLE TO SANITIZE DISHES PROPERLY. PIC WENT TO GROCERY STORE AND BOUGHT BLEACH.
